name: Mosaic Reveal Canvas
description: Full-screen canvas image that reveals a grid of zoomed mosaic tiles around the pointer, with optional dots and fade, easing back to the plain image as the pointer slows.
contents: Square canvas drawing one image as a tile grid
behavior: Tiles near the pointer show a zoomed crop of the image, scaling with pointer speed
Pointer position and reveal radius are smoothed with GSAP quickTo
Optional dots drawn at tile corners sized by reveal strength
Canvas keeps a square aspect and covers the viewport, pointer coordinates remap on resize
editableByProps: Image, background color, dot color and visibility, fade
Tile size, canvas resolution, dot size, easing and durations
fixed: Root is fixed and covers the viewport, centered on screen
Image must allow cross-origin canvas use
